displayPropertyTechnicalName.description:
Optional technical name of the dimension property whose values are exported for this field. When not set, the dimension's default property is used.

For a DimensionField, the property belongs to that dimension. For a ValueField, the metric must be of type dimension, and the property belongs to the dimension the metric references.
Properties of type Dimension, Permissions or AccessRights cannot be exported.
Several fields on the same dimension or metric must request the same property, unless the BlockExportDuplicateDisplayProperties feature flag is enabled.
Requires the BlockExportDisplayProperties feature flag.
